caption: The drawing is a monochromatic pencil illustration featuring a mechanical object composed of several cylindrical and rounded components. The main form consists of a large circular piece at the back, resembling a lid with a ring handle at the top center. Attached to the front of the lid is an arm-like structure connecting to a rounded, jar-like container with a domed cap. Protruding from the cap are three cylindrical rods with hexagonal bases. The composition focuses on the realistic rendering of the object with careful shading, giving a sense of metallic texture and dimensionality. In the lower left corner, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing depicting the same object from a different perspective, with a measurement labeled at the base (5 7/8). The entire drawing is set within a rectangular border, and the artist's signature, "A. Zeidenberg," is present in the lower right corner. The color scheme of the image is grayscale, utilizing various shades of black, gray, and white achieved through pencil shading.
title: Lamp
